text:
Ravi: Heads-up — SignalMesh sent the renewal with a new "hybrid usage" clause. They added a "precision surcharge" for embeddings >1024 dims. attached screenshot of clause. pls weigh in.
Lena: wow that's new. do we even use embeddings >1024 dims for SearchKit? unlikely on initial rollout.
Hector: we do for a couple of retrieval features, but volume is small. main ask: can we get them to remove the surcharge or only apply above a higher threshold (e.g., 2048 dims)?
Ravi: also noticed invoicing language changed: they plan to include an "estimated bill" mid-month and a final bill month-end. Procurement prefers a single final invoice per month. mid-month estimates break our AR automation.
VendorsBot: Vendor summary: SignalMesh — Security: A, Product Fit: B, Billing Maturity: C. Internal page: https://redwood-internal/vend/SignalMesh
Lena: ask sales for a sample invoice (CSV) and an explanation of how the mid-month "estimated" line will appear vs final. need exact SKU names for GL mapping.
Hector: on reconciliation side, request a daily usage export (CSV or S3 link) with fields: date, route, emb_dims, token_count, customer_id. we need per-route numbers to map to routes in our gateway.
Ravi: finance flag: we saw a 12% higher billed tokens last quarter vs our internal counters for one vendor. insist on a metering reconciliation window and a process to resolve >2% mismatches.
CFO-Mike: if metering mismatch >2% and vendor error is proven, require automatic credit equal to discrepancy amount on next invoice. also limit unapproved overages to +15%/mo.
Lena: negotiation levers: 1) exclude "precision surcharge" until after 6 months of production 2) if surcharge stays, cap it to $0.0001 per 1k tokens 3) pilot bucket of 250M tokens with full metering export and 90-day expiry not less than 60 days.
Hector: pipeline note: add a clause to convert unused pilot tokens to a one-time seat credit if unused after expiry. reduces revenue risk on both sides.
Ravi: good. I'm requesting sample invoice CSV + daily export + 12-month projection at our expected usage (SearchKit: 800M emb tokens/mo, 20k gen tokens). pinging AE at 2109987680.
VendorsBot: Contract checklist missing: SOC2 report, DPA, and invoice CSV API.
Lena: assign me to follow-up on metering schema. Hector, can you draft the short cost-sensitivity table (tokens +/-25%) so procurement can see worst-case bill?
Hector: on it. will share by EOD.
Ravi: once we have their sample invoice and commit on reconciliation terms, I'll open approval doc for legal + finance review.
CFO-Mike: don't approve renewal until metering reconciliation + overage cap agreed.
Lena: agreed. :white_check_mark:
